verses.text: “To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: The one who holds the seven stars in his right hand and walks among the seven golden lampstands says this:
I know what you do, your hard work and endurance. I know you can’t put up with evil people. You’ve tested those who claim to be apostles but aren’t, and you found them to be liars.
You’ve endured, suffered for my name, and haven’t grown tired.
But I have this against you: you’ve left the love you had at first.
So remember how far you’ve fallen. Turn back and do the things you did at first. If you don’t, I’ll come to you and remove your lampstand from its place.
But this is in your favor: you hate the practices of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
Anyone with ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who conquers, I’ll give the right to eat from the tree of life in God’s paradise.
“To the angel of the church in Smyrna write: The First and the Last, who died and came back to life, says this:
I know your suffering and poverty—though you’re rich! I know the slander from those who claim to be Jews but aren’t; they’re a synagogue of Satan.

Don’t be afraid of what you’re about to suffer. The devil will throw some of you into prison to test you, and you’ll suffer for ten days. Stay faithful, even to death, and I’ll give you the crown of life.
Anyone with ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who conquers won’t be hurt by the second death.
“To the angel of the church in Pergamum write: The one who has the sharp, double-edged sword says this:

I know where you live—where Satan’s throne is. Yet you remain true to my name. You didn’t deny your faith in me, even in the days of Antipas, my faithful witness, who was killed among you, where Satan lives.
But I have a few things against you: some among you hold to Balaam’s teaching. He taught Balak to trap the Israelites into eating food sacrificed to idols and committing sexual immorality.
In the same way, some among you hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
So turn back. Otherwise, I’ll come to you soon and fight against them with the sword of my mouth.

Anyone with ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who conquers, I’ll give some of the hidden manna. I’ll also give them a white stone, with a new name written on it that no one knows except the one who receives it.
“To the angel of the church in Thyatira write: The Son of God, whose eyes are like blazing fire and whose feet are like polished bronze, says this:
I know your deeds, your love and faith, your service and endurance, and that you’re doing more now than you did at first.
But I have this against you: you tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophet. By her teaching she misleads my servants into sexual immorality and eating food sacrificed to idols.
I’ve given her time to turn away from her immorality, but she refuses.
So I’ll throw her onto a bed of suffering, and those who commit adultery with her will suffer terribly unless they turn away from her ways.
I’ll strike her children dead. Then all the churches will know that I am the one who searches hearts and minds, and I’ll repay each of you according to what you’ve done.
But I say to the rest of you in Thyatira, who don’t hold this teaching and haven’t learned Satan’s so-called deep secrets: I won’t put any other burden on you.
Just hold on to what you have until I come.
To the one who conquers and does my will to the end, I’ll give authority over the nations.
They’ll rule them with an iron scepter and shatter them like pottery, just as I received authority from my Father.
I’ll also give them the morning star.
Anyone with ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
